name: Sana Malik
comment: Absolutely stunning quality! The embroidery on my lawn suit is so delicate — you can tell real care goes into each piece. Delivery was prompt and the packaging was beautiful. Already planning my next order!

name: Ayesha Siddiqui
comment: I ordered the embroidered chiffon suit for Eid and received so many compliments. The fabric drapes beautifully and the colours are exactly as shown. Solace by Fia has become my go-to for special occasions.

name: Rabia Noor
comment: Beautiful pieces, very true to the photos. The lawn quality is excellent — soft and cool in the summer heat. Wish the dupatta had a little more embroidery detail, but overall a very happy purchase.

name: Fatima Zahra
comment: The pashmina chaddar I received is absolutely gorgeous. Three months in and it still looks brand new. Worth every rupee — you can feel the quality the moment you hold it.

name: Maryam Hussain
comment: Ordered the ready-to-wear kurta and it fit perfectly. The embroidery at the neckline is so refined. Wore it to a daawat and everyone was asking where it was from. Love this brand!

name: Zainab Ali
comment: Great quality and lovely designs. The owner was very responsive and helpful throughout. My chaddar arrived beautifully pressed and packed. Would recommend to anyone who appreciates handcrafted clothing.
